gaps.sentence: The company was ___ up by a larger rival last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Take over/take up a company' — here 'was taken up' = absorbed by a bigger firm.

gaps.sentence: It's wise to look ___ before making a career move.
gaps.explanation: look ahead = think about and plan for the future.

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: Do you get ___ well with your new colleagues?
gaps.explanation: get on (with) = have a good relationship; also get along with (AmE).

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: The publishers are bringing ___ a revised edition in the spring.
gaps.explanation: 'Bring out' = produce and publish a new product or edition.
